description.narrative: The project will focus on enhancing urban planning, building community resilience, and providing infrastructure that will facilitate long-term sustainable and economic growth. The project is consistent with the strategic goals set in the government's RSIV and ADB Strategy 2030. It supports Strategy 2030's key operational priorities of tackling climate change, making cities more livable, strengthening governance and institutional capacity, and accelerating gender equality. It is also aligned with the draft Country Partnership Strategy 2019-2023, the GMS Urban Development Strategic Framework 2015-2022, and Cambodia's Industrial Development Policy (2015-2025), which provides the overarching vision that guides the Country Partnership Strategy.

description.narrative: Access to urban infrastructure and services in participating cities improved.

At least 23,960 people (of whom at least 12,110 are women) in the project area serviced by an improved drainage network Progress/Status: Similar progress as indicators a and b above. Data Source: Annual reports and quarterly project performance monitoring reports by the project management unit, Asian Development Bank review missions, project completion reports Actual value:

At least 26,850 people (of whom at least 13,650 are women) in the project area serviced by new and improved wastewater and collection treatment facilities Progress/Status: - Wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) and its sewage networks at Bavet was at 13% of completion. - The contract of WWTP at Poipet has just signed in February 2026. - DED of sewage network expansion at Kampot has been completed. Draft being documents are under revision based on ADB's comments. Data Source: Annual reports and quarterly project performance monitoring reports by the project management unit, Asian Development Bank review missions, project completion reports Actual value:

At least 632 poor and vulnerable households (including 90 households headed by women) in the project area provided with improved access to sanitation facilities Progress/Status: - Wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) and its sewage networks at Bavet was at 13% of completion. - The contract of WWTP at Poipet has just signed in February 2026. - DED of sewage network expansion at Kampot has been completed. Draft being documents are under revision based on ADB's comments. Data Source: Annual reports and quarterly project performance monitoring reports by the project management unit, Asian Development Bank review missions, project completion reports Actual value:

At least 91,130 people (of whom at least 46,000 are women) in the project area served by improved solid-waste management Progress/Status: - Bavet landfill construction has been completed. Arrangements to start its operation is ongoing. - Poipet landfill construction was at 5% of completion. Data Source: Annual reports and quarterly project performance monitoring reports by the project management unit, Asian Development Bank review missions, project completion reports Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Institutional effectiveness and governance improved. Indicator: At least 20 scholarships (master's or graduate level) awarded to female employees of Ministry of Public Works and Transport, provincial departments of public works and transport, and/or municipal administrations to study engineering and/or other relevant sciences at an accredited institution to advance their careers in the water and sanitation sector Progress/Status: 21 female scholars have been approved. Data Source: Quarterly project performance monitoring reports, project completion reports Actual value:

Output: Urban infrastructure improved. Indicator: Two landfills with combined capacity of 1,149,089 m3 constructed and operational ( Progress/Status: - Bavet landfill construction has been completed. Design capacity = 1.33M m3
- Poipet landfill construction was at 5% of completion. Design capacity = 1.11M m3 Data Source: Quarterly project performance monitoring reports, contractor's project construction records Actual value:

Output: Urban infrastructure improved. Indicator: Two wastewater treatment facilities with combined capacity of 13,506 m3/day constructed and operational Progress/Status: - Bavet WWTP construction was at 13% of completion. Design capacity = 5,440 m3/day
- Poipet WWTP contract was signed in February 2026. Works are expected in Q2 2026. Design capacity = 9,194 m³/day
- Bidding documents of Kampot sewage network expansion is being revised and expected to be advertised in Q2 2026. Data Source: Quarterly project performance monitoring reports, contractor's project construction records Actual value:

Output: Institutional effectiveness and governance improved. The TOR and MOU were jointly developed with TECHOSEN and approved by ADB and the PMU to ensure alignment with project objectives. Output: Policy and regulatory environment improved. Output: Policy and regulatory environment improved. Indicator: Provincial spatial plans and municipal land use plans developed Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Preparation of the provincial spatial plans (PSPs) for Kampot and Svay Rieng and land use management plans (LUMPs), and land use plans (LUPs) for Kampot, Bavet and Poipet cities under the original scope and the additional activities such as simplifying and disseminating two handbooks for the preparation of PSPs and LUMPs/LUPs, and legislative reviews related to spatial planning, land use plans have been completed.
